evidence.note: Dark folding chair is compactly folded in the non-window wall corner.
Chair fabric and frame fill the foreground during the unfolding manipulation.
Chair is visibly deployed with its seat, back, arms, and legs open.
Deployed chair remains close to the camera immediately before being put away.
Chair is again compactly folded and leaning in the corner.

events.object_description: Dark green/black folding camp chair at the interior wall corner

evidence.note: Second dark folding chair is compactly folded in the corner beside the bright window.
Chair fabric occupies the foreground as it is unfolded.
Chair is fully deployed beside the desk and window.
Chair remains deployed, viewed very close to its seat and back.
Chair has been folded compactly and returned to the window corner.

events.object_description: Dark green/black folding camp chair beside the desk and window

evidence.note: Blue folding chair is compactly folded in the corner beside the window.
Blue chair fabric fills the foreground during unfolding.
Blue chair is deployed with its seat, back, arms, and legs open.
The deployed chair is partly visible very close to the camera immediately before folding.
Blue chair is compactly folded in the corner again.

events.object_description: Blue folding camp chair beside the window and desk

notes: Three distinct localized folding-chair episodes are visible. Camera surveys and changes in viewpoint while each chair remains deployed are not counted as additional state changes.
scene_description: Bright bedroom containing a bed, standing desk, window, and several folding camp chairs stored in separate wall corners.
